category: ハイブリッド接続、経路、トラブルシューティング
title: Direction of Private DNS Queries
prompt: You need to resolve names in a private hosted zone associated with a VPC from on-premises DNS. The on-premises environment can reach the VPC.

choices.explanation: The on-premises DNS can conditionally forward queries to the VPC.

choices.text: Receive DNS queries through a NAT gateway.
choices.explanation: A NAT gateway is not the Resolver entry point for a private hosted zone.

choices.text: Use only a Resolver outbound endpoint.
choices.explanation: This handles queries originating in the VPC and going to external DNS.

learning.reason: The on-premises DNS can conditionally forward queries to the VPC.
learning.concept: Directions are distinguished relative to the VPC Resolver. Check both security groups and network routes.

category: ハイブリッド接続、経路、トラブルシューティング
title: Segment Isolation
prompt: You are connecting a development VPC and a production VPC with Transit Gateway, but you want both VPCs to reach only shared services.

choices.text: Associate all attachments with the same table and propagate all routes.
choices.explanation: This creates routes between the development and production VPCs as well.

choices.text: Create individual peering connections from every VPC to the production VPC.
choices.explanation: This adds direct connections to production and does not use TGW route control to limit access to shared services.

choices.text: Associate different TGW route tables and propagate or add only the required routes.
choices.explanation: This controls the reachable destinations for each source attachment.

learning.reason: This controls the reachable destinations for each source attachment.
learning.concept: An association determines the route table consulted by incoming traffic, while propagation registers routes in a route table.

category: ハイブリッド接続、経路、トラブルシューティング
title: Redundant VPN Failover
prompt: You want to make a Site-to-Site VPN redundant through independent connection paths and automatically switch routes when a tunnel fails.

choices.explanation: IP route selection is separate from DNS response caching.

choices.text: Maintain only static routes through the same tunnel
choices.explanation: This configuration does not provide another tunnel to use when the route becomes unavailable.

choices.text: Use BGP and verify route advertisements across multiple tunnels and route withdrawal during failures
choices.explanation: Routes can be recalculated dynamically according to tunnel status.

learning.reason: Routes can be recalculated dynamically according to tunnel status.
learning.concept: In addition to verifying route switching, test return paths and the convergence time permitted operationally.

category: ハイブリッド接続、経路、トラブルシューティング
title: Mitigating Asymmetric Routing
prompt: Traffic is sent through a Transit Gateway to inspection VPCs in multiple AZs. You want the bidirectional flow to pass through the same stateful inspection appliance.

choices.explanation: Increasing the address range does not keep the same AZ selected for a flow.

choices.text: Enable appliance mode on the inspection VPC attachment
choices.explanation: This design can keep the AZ selected by the inspection VPC attachment for the duration of the flow.

choices.text: Extend the retention period for VPC Flow Logs
choices.explanation: This records communications but does not control bidirectional route symmetry.

learning.reason: This design can keep the AZ selected by the inspection VPC attachment for the duration of the flow.
learning.concept: In addition to appliance mode, verify routing to the inspection appliance in both directions.

category: ハイブリッド接続、経路、トラブルシューティング
title: Connecting VPCs with Overlapping CIDRs
prompt: You want to expose only one TCP service behind an NLB between VPCs with overlapping CIDRs. Which approach is appropriate?

choices.explanation: The consumer connects through an endpoint without routing the entire VPCs to each other.

choices.text: Register the overlapping CIDRs on both sides through VPC peering
choices.explanation: Peering cannot be created for VPCs with overlapping CIDRs.
This does not resolve overlapping CIDRs between VPCs or service-level exposure.

learning.reason: The consumer connects through an endpoint without routing the entire VPCs to each other.
learning.concept: When access can be limited to a specific service, the networks do not need to be interconnected in their entirety.

category: ハイブリッド接続、経路、トラブルシューティング
title: Private Connectivity to S3 from On-Premises
prompt: You reach S3 from on-premises through a VPN. You do not want to use public destination IP addresses for S3.

choices.text: Use the S3 gateway endpoint in the VPC directly over the VPN
choices.explanation: Gateway endpoints cannot be used transitively from on-premises networks.

choices.text: Route traffic to the private IP addresses of an S3 interface endpoint
choices.explanation: The VPN can connect to the endpoint network interfaces in the VPC.

choices.text: Use a public NAT gateway to reach S3's public endpoint
choices.explanation: This does not meet the requirement to use private destination IP addresses.

learning.reason: The VPN can connect to the endpoint network interfaces in the VPC.
learning.concept: Verify endpoint DNS resolution, 443/TCP rules, and routing from the VPN together.
